en.title: Three workplaces of one medical information system
en.desc: The participant portal sends the application and questionnaire to the doctor portal, the doctor returns a decision. Then a clinic visit, where blood becomes a sample, and the aliquot station in the biobank. Sample stages return to the participant portal; there is no integration yet.

ru.label: Процесс контроля качества из пяти шагов: отбор разговоров, прослушивание, оценка по бланку, результат, спор. Выделен отбор разговоров, единственный шаг, который не проверялся.

en.label: A five-step quality control process: call selection, listening, scoring, result, dispute. Call selection is highlighted, the only step that was not checked.
en.cap: Quality control in the MANGO OFFICE contact center. Before the randomizer, every step was transparent except the first: the reviewer decided alone which calls to listen to.
